brief: `intarsia qualify` quick for the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B NVFP4 model on tatooine (HIP) exits 2: acc-short is ERROR, on main too. Make acc-short PASS or FAIL, fix the cause.
hypothesis: The ref-noise record in the repo is bound to a golden hash that differs from the golden tatooine's qualify picks; bringing tatooine's golden in line with the one CUDA and Metal use removes the ERROR without touching code or records.

code.diff_stat: docs and results only; the fix is a data change on tatooine (/data/models/intarsia/golden)

checks.name: golden hashes across hosts
checks.command: FNV-1a 64 of every qwen36-35b short/long vllm-top20 golden on endor, spark2, tatooine (scratch h.py, same function as baseline::fnv1a64)
checks.detail: short cd6ef94b3dcd4c82 and long 1c62c8e49c68fe34 everywhere, except tatooine's /data/models/intarsia/golden short file (b58845c3cb8a3cb6) before the fix

checks.name: qualify quick, 35B, tatooine HIP, origin/main a312a794

accuracy.gate: qualify acc-short vs vllm top20 golden (HIP)

summary: qualify acc-short on tatooine was ERROR because the golden directory held a stale 10-12 golden (b58845c3) under the canonical name while the rebuilt one (cd6ef94b, the golden endor and spark2 hold and the repo's ref-noise and baselines are bound to) sat beside it as '-meta', which qualify skips. Replaced the stale file by the canonical one on tatooine (stale kept as .stale-b58845c3); qualify quick for the 35B on origin/main now exits 0 with acc-short PASS (prefill KL 7.63e-3 top-1 98.61 %, decode KL 1.18e-2 top-1 98.75 %). No code or record change.
lessons: qualify matches goldens by name and ignores any file with 'meta' in it: never park a rebuilt golden beside the old one under a different name, replace it.
The ref-noise binding error names the golden hash; the 'golden: <path>' line printed just before it names the file qualify picked.
qualify --golden-dir replaces the default search list, so the checkout's golden/oracle/ is not searched and acc-oracle is MISSING-BASELINE (exit 1); omit it on tatooine.
